ruleDefinitions.name: Potential MsiExec Masquerading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of msiexec.exe from an uncommon directory

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "\\msiexec\.exe") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\")))
